note: Two reusable rules emerged from the review findings.

candidates.text: Avoid third-party services for rendering sensitive onboarding credentials; generate QR codes and similar one-user secrets locally.
candidates.rationale: The original implementation sent the tester’s deep link (containing the bot username and onboarding code) to an external QR API. Replacing it with a local encoder removes a privacy leak and an external runtime dependency.

candidates.text: Every webhook handler must have automated tests for each update type it routes.
candidates.rationale: The Telegram webhook handler was extended to route both callback queries and messages, but only callbacks had indirect coverage. Adding direct tests for secret validation, callback routing, and message routing caught the gap.
